scope: Independent installer-only source and existing-evidence review against frozen Go, bounded to the recorded public signed-install, source-detection, source-driven Windows and additive archive cases. This is not full archive grammar, native platform, whole updater or final gate approval.

frozen_go.comparison: Frozen installer source and official Go archive/tar and archive/zip source; additive synthetic probes retain their own exact source/compiler/probe provenance.

resolved_findings.finding: Declared EOCD count could hide later central directory entries, allowing candidate creation for a two-entry archive whose counts were patched to one.
resolved_findings.resolution: zip_members scans every consecutive central header, preserves the Go terminal EOF/UnexpectedEOF/ErrFormat distinctions, validates required ZIP64 extra widths, and compares actual member count modulo 65536 before returning members.
resolved_findings.evidence: One Go-first observation rejects with open zip release archive: unexpected EOF and zero candidate creation; its public Rust RED preceded the correction and now passes.

resolved_findings.finding: DOS directory attribution used creator 10 instead of Go NTFS creator 11, and unsupported UNIX file types were incorrectly treated as nonregular.
resolved_findings.resolution: DOS directory attribution now uses creators 0, 11 and 14; unsupported UNIX kinds retain Go regular-file/default permissions behavior.
resolved_findings.evidence: Three Go-first creator/type observations replay through public signed Install.

resolved_findings.finding: The normalizer omitted the historical GNU prefix fallback and differed on embedded-NUL octal fields, negative header-only sizes and invalid USTAR device fields.
resolved_findings.resolution: The recorded historical GNU unsafe prefix is rejected as ../escape/pixiv; embedded-NUL octal and negative header-only sizes follow Go; invalid USTAR devmajor is rejected.
resolved_findings.evidence: Four Go-first header observations, with public RED before production correction.

review_observations: Trusted signature and checksum verification precede archive extraction, candidate checking and target replacement for the reviewed public paths.
Archive member names are not used as extraction destinations; candidate writes use the fixed owned candidate path, after member validation.
Reviewed duplicate PAX/repeated GNU precedence, sparse 0.x/1.0 expansion and partial-error bytes, and old-GNU extension alignment follow their recorded Go cases.
The public filesystem witness records create_file and close-time candidate bytes, including error cases; failures retain the old target and successful rows alone reach the mock binary checker.
No original frozen expectation was changed to mask the reviewed differences.

focused_evidence.runtime_boundary: Synthetic signed dependencies and mock binary checker with owned Linux filesystem effects; candidates are never executed. Windows replacement observations are source-driven API mocks on owned Unix files.

limitations: Native Windows ABI, MoveFileEx/ReplaceFile behavior, native process execution and Windows filesystem behavior remain unverified; source-driven Windows tests are not native execution.
Native Darwin and other OS/architecture installer runtime behavior remain unverified by this review.
Arbitrary historical TAR numeric/header/path grammar, malformed extension combinations, sparse maps and archive truncation schedules beyond the recorded cases remain unverified.
Broader ZIP64, wrapped member counts, multiple EOCD records, central/local header interactions and arbitrary ZIP creator/attribute combinations beyond the recorded cases remain unverified.
Arbitrary filesystem races, ACLs and uncaptured I/O failures remain outside this bounded evidence.
Denied supplemental multiplex/upload/unfinished-HEAD probes remain unattempted; this artifact makes no native HTTP transport parity claim.
approval_conditions: Approval binds the exact installer source hash above and the listed existing focused evidence.
Any installer or evidence change requires renewed review of the affected scope.
The required root-owned full gate and final whole-candidate hash approval are separate and are not certified here.
No whole feature/platform status promotion, commit, push, release publication or additional native probe is authorized by this review.
